about:
Westfield Sheet Metal Works, Inc. has operated in Kenilworth, New Jersey since 1928 as a union shop affiliated with Sheet Metal Workers Union Local 22. The company occupies a 50,000-square-foot manufacturing and office facility on a 100,000-square-foot lot at North 8th Street and Monroe Avenue.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication from design through installation, handling projects that range from small machine guards to 10-by-10-foot plenums requiring crane lifts. In-house capabilities include engineering and project management, shearing, bending, welding, polishing, painting, quality control, and delivery, all coordinated from CAD drawings or sketches.

The firm serves architectural, commercial, construction, and manufacturing clients. Completed projects include the Streicker Bridge, light pylons for Gantry Plaza, structural elements for Hunters Point South Park, Madison Square Garden, and Hunts Point Landing. A historic-restoration contractor also cites Westfield for stainless-steel and copper components on landmark buildings.

Westfield emphasizes full-project control under one roof, with a union workforce guiding each job from initial sketch to final installation, and highlights on-time, on-budget delivery as a core differentiator.
